adjudicated.labeler: Claude (one labeller; not dual-labelled, so the corpus is not golden)

labelNotes: supply_voltage_V marked ABSENT: the Recommended Operating Conditions table has only 'Enable Input Voltage VEN 2.0-6.0 V' (no VIN/VCC row), and the pin table describes EN as a chip-enable/PWM input, so I did not treat it as a supply rail. Doubtful: the part has no other supply pin and the ILED(MAX) row says 'VCC=3.3 to 6.0V, Enable=VCC', so a reviewer may prefer VEN 2.0 MIN / 6.0 MAX as the supply range. 'VIN=3.6V' is the EC table-wide default and is not labelled. Quiescent current IQ 125 typ / 180 max uA (Typ/Max columns checked with pdftotext); its row condition ILED1=...=ILED4=20mA is the per-channel load current, written as IOUT = 20 mA (judgement call). Shutdown current 0.1 typ / 1 max uA ('Set EN Pin Low' is a mode, omitted). Abs max: Enable Input Voltage '-0.3 to 6.5' -> 6.5 ABS_MAX (an input-voltage row). No EN input current is printed on these pages.
